name: Jaagir Manor, Dudhwa - IHCL SeleQtions
why_it_matters: Heritage manor lodge restored under IHCL SeleQtions banner in Palia Kalan — the pre-safari base town for Dudhwa Tiger Reserve. Jaagir Pavilion serves a multi-cuisine menu that includes local Tharu-community dishes alongside the standard tandoori-continental rotation. Private dining and lounge bar for couples and small groups.
insider_tip: Buffet breakfast is the safest start before a 6am safari; ask the kitchen for a packed lunch box if your safari runs long. The Tharu-style thali is the local-distinctive dish — most lodges don't bother with regional cuisine.
signature_address: Vikram Van, Palia Kalan, Lakhimpur Kheri 262902

name: Dudhwa Tigerhino Resort restaurant
why_it_matters: Mid-range jungle resort restaurant in Palia, the closest town to Dudhwa Tiger Reserve. Standard multi-cuisine menu serving its safari-package guests. The fallback when Jaagir Manor is full or out of price range.
insider_tip: Most guests book half-board or full-board with the room — walk-in rates available but limited. Order tandoori for dinner; the kitchen runs it well.

name: Dudhwa Forest Rest House dining
why_it_matters: Uttar Pradesh Forest Department's Forest Rest House inside the Dudhwa core zone — basic kitchen serving residents staying at the FRH. Simple thali, no menu choice, but the closest dining to the Dudhwa interpretation centre and forest gate.
insider_tip: FRH stays must be booked through UP Forest Department; meals are coordinated with the caretaker the night before. Tea and biscuits are usually available on demand even for non-residents.

name: Tharu Hut Tourism Complex restaurant
why_it_matters: Government-run Tharu-style hutment tourism complex inside Dudhwa with attached dining — gives an experience of local Tharu tribal architecture alongside basic veg meals. Used by school and family groups on UP Tourism packages.
insider_tip: Book through UP Forest Department or UP Tourism — walk-ins are not standard. Treat as a heritage-immersion stay rather than a destination restaurant.
